the Ts-gamma neurotoxin from Tityus serratulatus venom is a 61 amino acids long polypeptide chain with a molecular mass of 6.7 kDa and isoelectric point of 7.8.
we isolated, crystallized and solved the structure of a scorpion toxin Ts-gamma from Tityus Serrulatus venom, which is a novel member of the scorpion toxin family.
we have purified Ts-gamma, crystallized and solved the structure of the protein by molecular replacement using Androctonus as a search model.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation, purification and crystallization of the scorpion toxin Ts-gamma.
the crystallization, structure and molecular modeling of neurotoxins from the scorpion T. serrulatus.
the structure and function of the scorpion neurotoxins.

the Ts-gamma structure is very similar to that of Androctonus, with a root-mean-square difference (RMSD) of 0.7 A for 88 C alpha atoms, which are 100% superimposable.
the present study provides an excellent basis to further elucidate the molecular basis of the neurotoxicity of Ts-gamma.
the Ts-gamma structure is a very important contribution to scorpion neurotoxin research and to the understanding of the structure-function relationships of this family of toxins.

the structure determination of Ts-gamma will provide the opportunity to study a new neurotoxin from the scorpion venom, which will be of interest for the development of antivenom and for the understanding of scorpion neurotoxin action.
